adaptations: Stable Underworld entry point and server 2.10 retained; no source main, UI dependency or vanilla entity override.
Original six combat modules and 35 enchanted handlers, scoped event dispatcher and lazy roster scheduler.
Original minion glaive/frost equipment and only its component/attachable dependencies; unrelated maps and bonus gear excluded.
Bonus loot functions use Underworld structure loot; original direct loot and three key items retained.
Original dormant Baelgor texture/model, unique fullbright controller; original custom audio restored including command-triggered sounds.
Shared source animation files trimmed to referenced definitions; no player animation overrides.
Enchanted Tower Wraith added with original baseline; isolated enchanted arrow supports original growing properties without overriding vanilla arrows.
Source null-owner, five-minion assignment, dead-chain removal and delayed invalid-entity bugs guarded.
Native Unicode enchant glyph avoids replacing shared font atlases used by other packs.
Glint material and custom arrow geometry scoped; original texture-set/MER companions retained.
Requested primary entity/egg display names applied; source key/equipment names explicitly localized.
Radiance ally lookup and removed-caster guards fixed without changing numerical effect values.
Dormant bosses placed once at verified authored markers in new matching structures only. A saved per-site claim prevents duplicates/respawns; no ongoing checks or existing-world backfill.

v0.2.109: Withered Heart, Weeping Soul and Ruinous Ember are placeholder ingredients, each guaranteed once in its matching boss direct loot pool. Temporary icons reuse the respective existing key artwork; no Grimoire recipe implemented.

v0.2.110: restored the original Malzareth server casting controller; repaired tag-gated teleports, local landing/collision checks, projectile hurt targets, and Nerezhal Nether home/stone-floor abilities; native active/dormant boss fire/lava immunity in every damage-sensor phase. Bounded combat jobs add no idle polling.

v0.2.111: requested near-Brute base hits: necromancer projectiles and Tower Wraith spell opening hits use 6/10/14 raw damage on Easy/Normal/Hard; lingering Tower Wraith pulses use 1/1.5/2. Fire patches share per-cast hit history; no new idle polling. Necromancer enchanted/upstream damage multipliers preserved. Other wraith and boss hazards unchanged.

v0.2.113: native boss projectile impact damage, non-AI phase/cooldown timers, Nerezhal retreat and hurt/close-range teleport restoration, bounded pillar-aware teleport landings, reload phase recovery without health reset, and event-driven lords_status combat telemetry. Automated JSON sequence models do not replace Bedrock combat acceptance.

v0.2.114: native trial encounter pools select Tower Wraith family 25%, Necromancer 25%, Piglin Brute 50%. Tower Wraith share includes 10% declared enchanted variants; Necromancer retains its original native 1:9 enchanted spawn event. Core imported resources are unchanged.

v0.2.115: reliable queued boss event bridge replaces assumed empty/property-only native notifications, with native duplicates suppressed. Deferred projectile ownership, floor-clear storm origin, illusion despawn, ground-hazard lifetime/pulses, and owner-scoped Blaze cap repair existing attacks. Hard raw native damage 96 standard, 160 powerful, 208 point-blank shockwave preserving rounded distance falloff, 32 armour-ignoring floor fire. Native defences retained; actual Bedrock health-loss acceptance pending. Opt-in actual-health telemetry uses hurt events only.

v0.2.118: audited arena casters. Reliable queued delivery for Necromancer summon markers, Tower Wraith poison creation and shared Wraith fire initialization/hits; native half-second entity-sensor fire pulses replace AI timer flags, with collisionless off-ground despawn removed. Local floor searches prevent upper-storey/Nether roof placement, self-duplicate removal and missing-neighbor spread aborts. Regular/enchanted support Wraith teleports use bounded safe local floors; missing biome data falls back to normal zombie summons. Base damage, enchanted chances, projectile cadence and summon limits retained. Automated BP event-pipeline models pass; native AI/aim/render acceptance pending.
